note: Two more Qollab runs of the Field tracker's one-job circuit, on the free local simulators a judge may pick in Qollab's Run dialog (an IBM noise model and AWS Braket). Recorded on 2026-10-11 from the project draft (edit mode). The console lines are copied as Qollab printed them; the run-card values were read off the screen and the counts were not exported.

runs.qollab_backend_label: IBM: Boston (Heron r3 arch, 156q), noise model, free (console: IBM Boston simulator (Heron r3 arch, 156q))
console: [Entangled Compass] running on fake_boston (ibm_fake). Printed here: the Overview numbers, each replay, each challenge round, the 3D compass and every circuit run.

[Entangled Compass] Overview (model replay, 1000 shots per register per minute): on the quiet day GHZ-4 is 2.01× (± 0.02, 2 SE over 16 replays) as precise as 8 independent qubits (ideal 2.00); with IonQ Aria 1 gate noise 1.94× (± 0.03, 2 SE over 16 replays); with dephasing 0.2 1.10× (± 0.01, 2 SE over 16 replays). Storm of May 2024 (quick estimate, 8 replays): GHZ-4 alone changes fringe 20 times, the cascade 0 times.

[Entangled Compass] One-minute circuit on fake_boston (17 qubits, 200 shots, 14.151 s): canary 99.0%, field step +44.59 nT; cascade error +0.34 nT, GHZ-4 alone -78.20 nT, 2 independent qubits +1.11 nT.
